questions.stem: 在許多居民世代居住的漁村，房屋和農田正逐漸被上升的海水淹沒。
questions.answer: In many fishing villages where residents have lived for generations, houses and fields are gradually being flooded by the rising sea.
accepted_answers: In many fishing villages in which people have lived for generations, homes and farmland are slowly being swallowed up by rising seawater.
Houses and farms are gradually being covered by the rising sea in many fishing villages where families have lived for generations.

questions.stem: 無論海堤蓋得多高，都無法永遠保護那些受到海水威脅的城鎮。
questions.answer: No matter how high the sea walls are built, they can't permanently protect the towns that are threatened by the sea.
accepted_answers: No matter how tall the sea walls are, they cannot protect the towns that are under threat from the sea forever.
No matter how high sea walls are made, they will not permanently protect the towns that are threatened by seawater.

1.explanation_zh: 「居民世代居住的漁村」是地點＋修飾子句，子句裡缺的是地點，用關係副詞 where（＝in which）：fishing villages where residents have lived for generations；「世代居住」延續到現在，用現在完成式。「正逐漸被…淹沒」同時是進行與被動：are gradually being flooded by …。「上升的海水」是 the rising sea（rise 不及物，不要寫 raising）。
evidence: 正逐漸被上升的海水淹沒
1.strategy_zh: 修飾地點的「…的＋地方」，子句裡若主詞、受詞都齊全，用 where；「正在被…」用 be being p.p.。
hints: 切成四段：在許多居民世代居住的漁村／房屋和農田正逐漸被／上升的海水／淹沒
標的詞彙：village（村莊）、resident（居民）、generation（世代）、gradually（逐漸地）、flood（淹沒）、rise（上升）
句型框架：In + N(地點) + where + S + have p.p. …, S + are (gradually) being p.p. + by …

2.explanation_zh: 「無論…多高」用 no matter how + 形容詞 + 主詞 + 動詞（＝however high …），how high 不可拆開，子句用直述句語序。「都無法」的「都」是語氣，不必譯 all；「永遠」可用 permanently（放動詞前）或 forever（放句尾）。「那些受到海水威脅的城鎮」用關係代名詞子句 the towns that are threatened by the sea；城鎮是被威脅的一方，用被動。
2.strategy_zh: 「無論多＋形容詞」→ No matter how + 形容詞 + S + V；長的「…的＋名詞」改成名詞 + that 子句。
hints: 切成四段：無論海堤蓋得多高／都無法永遠保護／那些受到海水威脅的／城鎮
標的詞彙：sea wall（海堤）、protect（保護）、permanently（永久地）、threaten（威脅）、town（城鎮）
句型框架：No matter how + adj. + S + V, S + can't + V + N + that + be p.p. …

references: In many fishing villages where residents have lived for generations, houses and fields are gradually being flooded by the rising sea.
In many fishing villages in which people have lived for generations, homes and farmland are slowly being swallowed up by rising seawater.
Houses and farms are gradually being covered by the rising sea in many fishing villages where families have lived for generations.

patterns.label_zh: 被動語態（進行式被動 be being p.p.）

parts.zh: 在許多居民世代居住的漁村
accepted: In many fishing villages where residents have lived for generations
In many fishing villages in which people have lived for generations
in many fishing villages where families have lived for generations
In many fishing villages where people have lived for generations

common_errors.wrong: In many fishing villages which residents have lived for generations
common_errors.right: In many fishing villages where residents have lived for generations
common_errors.explanation_zh: live 是不及物動詞，子句缺的是地點，要用 where（＝in which），不能只用 which。

common_errors.right: where residents have lived for generations
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「世代居住」一直延續到現在，用現在完成式 have lived。

accepted: houses and fields are gradually being
homes and farmland are slowly being
Houses and farms are gradually being
houses and farmland are gradually being
houses and fields are slowly being

common_errors.wrong: houses and field is gradually being
common_errors.right: houses and fields are gradually being
common_errors.explanation_zh: 兩個名詞以 and 連接是複數主詞，動詞用 are；field 可數，用複數。

common_errors.right: houses and fields are gradually being flooded
common_errors.explanation_zh: 房屋和農田是「被」淹沒，而且「正」在發生，用進行式被動 are being flooded。
海水自己「上升」用不及物動詞 rise（rising）；raise 是及物動詞「舉起、提高」。
表示正在上升，用現在分詞 rising 修飾名詞。
被動式要用過去分詞 flooded。
drown 多指人或動物溺水；房屋、農田被水淹沒用 flood／submerge／swallow up，而且要用被動。

traps.literal_error: In many fishing villages …, houses and fields gradually flood by the rising sea.
traps.explanation_zh: 「正…被…」要同時表現進行和被動：are (gradually) being flooded。

traps.literal_error: In many residents living for generations fishing villages, …
traps.explanation_zh: 修飾地點的子句要放在名詞後面，用關係副詞 where：fishing villages where residents have lived for generations。

1.restructuring_zh: 中文「在…的漁村，房屋和農田正被…淹沒」以地點開頭；英文可保留 In many fishing villages where …, 也可把主詞 Houses and farms 提前、地點放句尾；「正逐漸被淹沒」用進行式被動 are gradually being flooded。

references: No matter how high the sea walls are built, they can't permanently protect the towns that are threatened by the sea.
No matter how tall the sea walls are, they cannot protect the towns that are under threat from the sea forever.
No matter how high sea walls are made, they will not permanently protect the towns that are threatened by seawater.

patterns.label_zh: 讓步：無論多…（no matter how + adj.）
patterns.frame: No matter how + adj. + S + V, S + V …

patterns.label_zh: 關係代名詞 that／which 引導的形容詞子句

accepted: No matter how high the sea walls are built
No matter how tall the sea walls are
No matter how high sea walls are made
However high the sea walls are
No matter how high we build sea walls

common_errors.wrong: No matter how the sea walls are built high
common_errors.right: No matter how high the sea walls are built
common_errors.explanation_zh: no matter how 後面要緊接形容詞或副詞（how high），再接主詞與動詞。

common_errors.wrong: No matter how high are the sea walls
common_errors.right: No matter how high the sea walls are
common_errors.explanation_zh: no matter how 子句用直述句語序，不要倒裝成問句。
這裡的「都」是配合「無論」的語氣，不必譯成 all。
forever 通常放在句尾；要放在動詞前面改用 permanently。

accepted: that are threatened by the sea
that are under threat from the sea
which are threatened by the sea

common_errors.right: that are threatened by the sea
common_errors.explanation_zh: 城鎮是「受到」威脅，關係子句要用被動 are threatened。

common_errors.wrong: that are threatening by the sea
common_errors.right: that are threatened by the sea
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「受到威脅」是被動，用過去分詞 threatened，不用 threatening。
「那些城鎮」是複數 towns，關係子句的動詞 are 也要和複數先行詞一致。
「那些」是複數，用 those（或 the）；that 是單數。

traps.literal_error: No matter how the sea walls are built high, …
traps.explanation_zh: how high 是一個整體，要一起放在 no matter 後面：No matter how high the sea walls are built。

traps.literal_error: … they can't permanently protect those threatened by the sea towns.
traps.explanation_zh: 修飾語「受到海水威脅的」要放在名詞後面，用關係子句 the towns that are threatened by the sea。

bonus.text: However high the sea walls may be built, they cannot shield the towns that are threatened by the sea forever.
bonus.explanation_zh: However + 形容詞 + S + may + V 是 no matter how 的正式寫法；shield（遮擋保護）比 protect 更生動。

2.restructuring_zh: 「無論…多高」英文要把 how high 放在一起：No matter how high the sea walls are built；「都」不必譯出；「受到海水威脅的城鎮」改成後位關係子句 the towns that are threatened by the sea。

1.translation: In many fishing villages where residents have lived for generations, houses and farmland are gradually being submerged by rising seawater.
1.explanation_zh: 「許多」我讀成修飾「漁村」（許多〔居民世代居住的〕漁村），因為「許多居民世代居住」語意不自然；關係副詞 where 引導形容詞子句，「世代居住」用現在完成式 have lived for generations；「正逐漸被…淹沒」用現在進行式被動 are gradually being submerged。

2.translation: No matter how high seawalls are built, they cannot protect the towns threatened by the sea forever.
2.explanation_zh: 「無論…多高」用 No matter how + adj（也可用 However high）；「受到海水威脅的城鎮」用過去分詞片語 threatened by the sea 後位修飾；「永遠」放句尾 forever。

issues_zh: （輕微歧義）「在許多居民世代居住的漁村」的「許多」可以讀成修飾「漁村」或「居民」；我讀成「許多漁村」，和參考譯文一致。若學生讀成 fishing villages where many residents have lived，第 1 部分會被判錯；建議中文改成「在居民世代居住的許多漁村」。

「受到海水威脅的城鎮」我自然寫成過去分詞片語 the towns threatened by the sea（沒有 that are），所以 used_patterns 不含 REL：REL 定義是「關係代名詞 that／which 引導的形容詞子句」，中文沒有唯一引出它；第 3 部分 accepted 也收 threatened by the sea，和 REL 的定義不一致。建議把 REL 放寬成「後位修飾（that 子句或分詞片語皆可）」。

R1 把 forever 放在句尾（… the towns that are under threat from the sea forever），可被讀成修飾 are under threat（永遠受威脅），語意有歧義；建議把「永遠」移到動詞旁，例如 they cannot permanently protect the towns that are under threat from the sea。我的譯文 forever 放句尾也有輕微同樣問題。
第 2 部分 accepted 有 they cannot protect（沒有「永遠」），R1 的 forever 又不在任何部分，學生漏譯「永遠」時依 4 部分扣不到分；建議第 2 部分 accepted 刪掉 they cannot protect，或註明須搭配句尾 forever 才算完整。
